fr_boulier_noun.hook: A little toy BULL rides on top of the ABACUS and the class cheers "YAY!": BULL-YAY = boo-LYAY. Tap it to hear the numbers!
fr_boulier_noun.why: Old hook needed the French word boule; now a painted toy bull on the abacus gives an English sound-alike.

fr_chiffre_noun.hook: "SHEEFR" ≈ SHEAF + ruh: a golden SHEAF of wheat wears a tag with counting marks — un chiffre is a digit, a figure.
fr_chiffre_noun.why: RECS p15: the numeral 7 on the tag was text; repainted as tally marks.

fr_trois_num.hook: "TRWAH" ≈ "THROW, AH!": a boy THROWS three red beanbags at the hoop - AH! - count them: TROIS = THREE.
fr_trois_num.why: Painted as a beanbag throw (three beanbags) instead of a juggler, so it does not clash with six (the girl juggling by the see-saw).

fr_sept_num.hook: "SET" (p is silent): the tennis girl is ready for a SET - count the balls in a row by her basket: SEVEN.
fr_sept_num.why: The balls now lie in a countable row of seven next to the tipped-over basket.

fr_dix_num.hook: "DEESS": THESE! The girl in the red cardigan holds up all TEN fingers.
fr_dix_num.why: The painted child holding up ten fingers is a girl.

fr_treize_num.hook: "TREZ": TRAYS standing in a row on the stall - THIRTEEN of them.
fr_treize_num.why: The trays are painted standing upright in one row so all thirteen can be counted.

fr_dix_huit_num.hook: "deez-WEET": THESE SWEETS by the empty jar - three rows of six, ten plus eight: DIX-HUIT = EIGHTEEN.
fr_dix_huit_num.why: The sweets are laid out in three rows of six beside the jar so the eighteen can be counted.

fr_dix_sept_num.hook: "deess-SET": a DICE SET on the tray - fifteen dice with two more stacked on top, ten plus seven: SEVENTEEN.
fr_dix_sept_num.why: The dice are painted as five-by-three plus two stacked, so seventeen can be counted.

fr_quatorze_num.hook: "ka-TORZ": a CAT with a TORCH sits on the sweets-stall roof: FOURTEEN. (Quatre-torze: you can hear the four in it.)
fr_quatorze_num.why: Tells the learner where the cat is at the fair.

fr_au_det.hook: "OH" ≈ "OAR": an OAR waits in the little rowing boat - let's go TO THE boat: AU bateau (à + le = au).
fr_au_det.why: The model village shows a rowing boat with its oar; there is no man holding it.

fr_son_det.hook: "SOHN": the SON pushes HIS toy sailing ship along the river: SON = HIS / HER (before a masculine word).
fr_son_det.why: The painting shows the boy and his ship, without the father.

fr_notre_det.hook: "NOTR": the little girl points at the model NOTRE-DAME cathedral - OUR Lady: NOTRE = OUR.
fr_notre_det.why: Says where the cathedral is in the model village.

fr_un_det.hook: "UHN" (nasal): the mime holds up ONE finger: UN = A / ONE, masculine.
fr_un_det.why: The child holding up one finger is a mime.

fr_ton_det.hook: "TOHN": the strongman lifts a huge iron weight - here is YOUR TON of iron! TON = YOUR (friendly).
fr_ton_det.why: The strongman is a child in a striped costume on the stage.

fr_vingtaine_noun.hook: "van-TEN": a white VAN carries TWENTY footballs on its roof rack, two rows of TEN: une vingtaine = about twenty.
fr_vingtaine_noun.why: Scene shows the van with exactly 20 footballs (2 × 10); the old hook said marbles.

fr_trente_num.hook: "TRAHNT" ≈ TRAIN: a toy TRAIN pulls 3 wagons of 10 yellow balls = THIRTY.
fr_trente_num.why: Old hook counted thirty wheels, which can't be painted countably; the wagons give 3 × 10.

fr_quarante_num.hook: "ka-RAHNT": CARROTS and a big ANT: the table holds 4 rows of 10 carrots = FORTY, and the ANT waits on the grass in front.
fr_quarante_num.why: Matches the painted table: exactly 4 × 10 carrots, one big ant in front.

fr_cinquante_num.hook: "sank-AHNT": the boat is so heavy it nearly SANK, with an ANT on the mast: 5 crates of 10 apples = FIFTY.
fr_cinquante_num.why: Matches the painted boat on the pond: 5 crates × 10 apples, ant on the mast.

fr_soixante_num.hook: "swa-SAHNT": a SWAN at the corner of the SAND, which holds 6 rows of 10 shells = SIXTY.
fr_soixante_num.why: Matches the sandpit: exactly 6 × 10 shells, swan at the back corner.

fr_quatre_vingts_num.hook: "katr-VAN": a CAT (quatre) by 4 little VANS (vingt), each carrying 20 balls in 4 rows of 5: 4 × 20 = EIGHTY.
fr_quatre_vingts_num.why: Matches the painted vans: 4 vans × 20 balls (4 rows of 5 each).

fr_a_prep.hook: "AH!": a girl in a yellow raincoat runs TO her kneeling grandpa, who opens his arms: "Ah!"
fr_a_prep.why: Painted front left: the girl runs to the grandpa (à = to).

fr_en_prep.hook: "ON": a girl IN her red pedal car pedals on and on.
fr_en_prep.why: Painted front centre: she sits in the car (en voiture).

fr_dans_prep.hook: "DANCE": she dances INSIDE her red hula hoop.
fr_dans_prep.why: Painted centre: the girl is inside the hoop (dans = in, inside).

fr_sur_prep.hook: "SURF": a surfer boy in board shorts stands ON a wooden crate, his surfboard beside him.
fr_sur_prep.why: Painted centre left: the boy stands on the crate (sur = on).

fr_par_prep.hook: Golf "PAR": an old golfer putts his ball THROUGH a wire hoop.
fr_par_prep.why: Painted back right: the ball rolls through the hoop (par = through).

fr_chez_prep.hook: "Chef SHAY": a moustached chef waves you in at the door of his little red-roofed hut — come to Shay's place.
fr_chez_prep.why: Painted back left: at the chef's home (chez = at someone's place).

fr_sous_prep.hook: "SOUP": a boy in striped pyjamas sits UNDER a little table that holds his bowl of soup.
fr_sous_prep.why: Painted front right: the boy is under the table (sous = under).

fr_devant_prep.hook: "DIVAN": a man in a brown suit stands IN FRONT OF a blue divan.
fr_devant_prep.why: Painted right centre: he stands in front of the sofa (devant = in front of).

fr_parmi_prep.hook: "PALMY": a girl in orange dungarees hides AMONG three palms in baskets.
fr_parmi_prep.why: Painted back centre: the girl is among the palms (parmi = among).

fr_vous_pron.hook: "VIEW": the butler bows and steps aside so the two grannies get the best VIEW from the window: "after VOUS, ladies!" VOUS = YOU (polite, or more than one).
fr_vous_pron.why: Painted back left: butler, two grannies, window.

fr_on_pron.hook: "ON": the girl switches the lamp ON, as ONE does every evening: ON = ONE, PEOPLE, WE in general.
fr_on_pron.why: Painted back centre: girl at the glowing lamp.

fr_lui_meme_pron.hook: "LOUIE MEMo": LOUIE paints a MEMento of HIMSELF: LUI-MÊME = HIMSELF.
fr_lui_meme_pron.why: Painted back right: the boy paints his own portrait, mirror beside him.

fr_elle_pron.hook: "BELL": she rings her BELL: ELLE = SHE.
fr_elle_pron.why: Painted middle left: girl ringing a brass bell.

fr_nous_pron.hook: "NOODLE": two friends share one bowl, slurping the two ends of one long NOODLE: NOUS = WE, US.
fr_nous_pron.why: Painted centre: two children, one bowl, one noodle.

fr_toi_pron.hook: "TOY": the boy holds up his TOY horse and gives YOU a thumbs-up: "c'est pour TOI!" TOI = YOU (stressed, friendly).
fr_toi_pron.why: Painted middle right: boy, wooden toy horse, thumbs-up.

fr_se_pron.hook: "SUDS": he lathers the SUDS and shaves HIMSELF: il SE rase. SE = HIMSELF, HERSELF, EACH OTHER.
fr_se_pron.why: Painted front left: man with shaving suds at the mirror.

fr_te_pron.hook: "TEDdy": a TEDdy for YOU: je TE donne. TE = YOU, TO YOU (friendly).
fr_te_pron.why: Painted front right: girl holding out a teddy bear to you.
